# David Ruck

Official website: https://davidaruck.com/

David Ruck is a Christchurch, New Zealand founder and operator with experience across sales, telecommunications, digital services, business discovery, media, music and infrastructure development.

This is a curated personal/professional site. It intentionally combines current business work with selected career stories, media history, music and first-person observations. America First Limited is the more formal corporate surface.
